source: FIGURES.md adapted from people to clubs, 2026-09-22, tool switch in effect: search demand from Google Ads Keyword Planner and live Google search rather than Ahrefs (KEYWORD-METHOD.md). S1 search demand; S4 the consensus lists actually read (RA's 2026 guide, Time Out Paris, Do It In Paris, Tripadvisor's 15 Best, access.sb's Top 10, read only as an aggregate web-search snippet, not each list in full); S5 history (English Wikipedia and press for Le Palace, Les Bains Douches, Fabrice Emaer; Resident Advisor, DJ Mag and Calrave for Rex Club). Rule: required means 3+ sources or S5 at all.

required_records.title: Le Palace
required_records.why: opened 1 March 1978 by Fabrice Emaer, one of the two rooms that invented Paris nightclubbing as spectacle (S5)
required_records.no_embed_reason: a club, closed; no working room or recording survives

required_records.title: Les Bains Douches
required_records.why: opened December 1978 in a former 1885 bathhouse; the Studio 54 of Paris (S5)
required_records.embed_note: exterior photograph only; the interior no longer exists as a club

required_records.title: Rex Club
required_records.why: opened 1988 at the start of the acid house wave; the only club on this page open continuously since (S1, S4 via RA, S5)
required_records.no_embed_reason: a club; its French connection is carried by the Dégénération remix below

required_records.title: Dégénération (Remix)
required_records.why: the owner's own remix of a major French pop record, placed beside Rex Club as the page's French musical connection, not as a claim that the original was played there

required_records.title: Badaboum
required_records.why: named by 2 of the 4 consensus lists read this pass (RA, Tripadvisor), with a real description read from RA rather than a name-only mention

required_records.title: Essaim
required_records.why: named by 2 of the 4 consensus lists read this pass (RA, Do It In Paris), both via the Canal Saint-Martin cluster, with a real description read from RA

required_records.title: La Station
required_records.why: named once (RA), included on strength of a distinctive, actually-read description (a former coal train station, Gare des Mines, queer and grassroots collectives) rather than the site's usual 3-source bar

optional_records.title: Fvtvr
optional_records.why: named by 2 of the 4 consensus lists read this pass, but no description was read for it; left out of the visible table for that reason

optional_records.title: La Java
optional_records.why: named once, no description read; left out of the visible table

known_gaps.title: Time Out Paris and access.sb full lists
known_gaps.why: read only as aggregate web-search snippets, not opened and read in full; a name either list carries that this page omits would be a real gap, not yet checked

known_gaps.title: Rex Club and specific artists (Daft Punk, Laurent Garnier)
known_gaps.why: one low-authority ticketing site (outgoing.world) names them as having 'made history' at Rex Club; not corroborated by a second source, so the claim is left out of the article rather than printed on one source

known_gaps.title: Le Palace's closing date
known_gaps.why: sources agree Emaer died in 1983 after falling ill in 1982, but no source read gives an exact closing date for the club itself
